design: Fixed before training or observing new teacher outcomes. Same hidden frames and candidate streams, final-only training on parity or disjoint triplet-majority product, evaluating all retrieved paths and both readouts on the same clean held-out inputs.
primary: At the 131072-label endpoint, initial Adam rate .020, compare mean difference in clean exact-path agreement rates (majority-product-trained minus parity-trained). Independent paired teachers (n=16). Two-sided exact sign test omitting ties (alpha=.05). Difference in percentage points with percentile teacher-paired bootstrap using 50000 draws, numpy PCG64 seed 7534017.
secondary: No search for learning rate, budget or seed. Report both rates, checkpoints, both deployment tasks, and native errors, plus exact path agreement for both. Test-only truth paths shared across evaluations. Only primary is confirmatory, all other summaries pointwise descriptive. Independently flipped final labels at probability 0.10, with same per-record sign flip between two tasks. Same architecture and Gaussian small init, common record stream, keys, paired teachers and 8192 heldout records; one online pass. Sufficient fixed label budget; no process supervision.
